cause: the widget's filter representation is restricted to two specific effects.
fix_direction: provide a renderer-neutral representation for the required filter forms and explicitly report unsupported backend execution where applicable.
impact: an app cannot express a backdrop dilation or a composed backdrop filter through this widget.
limitations: Source reading only; no scenario or pixel evidence. Dilation and compose filters not exercised.
title: BackdropFilter cannot accept general image filters

cause: Incular stores `Contain` as the default where Flutter defers to `paintImage`'s scale-down default.
fix_direction: make the default represent Flutter's nullable fit or use scale-down when fit is omitted.
impact: a smaller source remains at native size in Flutter but is enlarged to fill the destination in Incular.
limitations: Pixel values were measured at revision a425aa2e; re-measure at HEAD before relying on magnitudes.
title: Image defaults scale small sources up

cause: Incular uses an explicit cover fit instead of preserving Flutter's omitted-fit behavior.
fix_direction: align the default to scale-down while retaining explicit `Cover` for callers who request it.
impact: default decoration images can be enlarged and cropped in Incular where Flutter keeps them at or below intrinsic size.
limitations: Pixel values were measured at revision a425aa2e; re-measure at HEAD before relying on magnitudes.
title: DecorationImage defaults to cover instead of scale-down

cause: the lowering discards every physical property except the static path and child.
fix_direction: retain a physical-shape render representation carrying the clip mode, fill and elevation/shadow properties.
impact: a `PhysicalShape` does not paint its configured surface or elevation shadow, and Incular clips by default when Flutter's default does not.
limitations: Pixel values were measured at revision a425aa2e; re-measure at HEAD before relying on magnitudes.
title: PhysicalShape drops fill, elevation, shadow and clip behavior

cause: physical-model conversion substitutes decoration and shadow widgets without preserving shape or clipping.
fix_direction: preserve the model shape and clip behavior through paint lowering.
impact: callers cannot request a circular physical model, and a child that should be clipped can paint beyond the model boundary.
limitations: Diagnostic: Flutter requests a circle while Incular has no shape option; the clip-behavior claim is source-only.
title: PhysicalModel ignores its shape and clipBehavior

cause: `ClipRSuperellipse` is lowered to the RRect clip path instead of the existing superellipse path primitive.
fix_direction: preserve the rounded-superellipse clip geometry through render lowering.
impact: corners follow circular rounded-rectangle arcs instead of Flutter's squircle profile, visibly changing the clipped edge at larger radii.
limitations: Pixel values were measured at revision a425aa2e; re-measure at HEAD before relying on magnitudes.
title: ClipRSuperellipse is rendered as a rounded rectangle

cause: the public matrix layout matches but the channel and bias normalization contracts differ.
fix_direction: convert Flutter-style matrix bias values to Incular's normalized representation at the widget boundary, or expose and document a parity-compatible matrix constructor.

cause: The decoration painter implements the common paths and records the remaining Flutter fields without consuming them.
evidence: box_painter.rs:281-282 documents that the background blend mode and an image centerSlice are not applied. rg finds no read of background_blend_mode, center_slice or match_text_direction outside construction, validation and lerp, and box_painter.rs never reads BoxShadow.blur_style (shadows blur as Normal).
fix_direction: Either paint the four parameters or reject them at construction (validation already exists for blend without fill) so that unsupported settings are not silently ignored.
impact: Callers set blend modes, nine-slice center slices, text-direction mirroring and blur styles that have no effect on the painted output, with no error.
limitations: Source reading only; no scenario. Existing validation (is_valid) is unaffected.
title: Accepted paint parameters are stored but never painted
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

cause: The ShapeBorder family was implemented for the shapes the framework itself needed.
evidence: rg for CircleBorder, OvalBorder, Beveled, Continuous and LinearBorder in crates/*/src returns nothing. ShapeBorder implementations are the four listed in shape_borders.rs. Circular decoration exists only as BoxShape::Circle, which is not a ShapeBorder and cannot be passed to ShapeDecoration or ClipPath::shape.
fix_direction: Add ShapeBorder implementations for the missing shapes, with outer_path and paint, and make BoxShape::Circle convertible to CircleBorder.
impact: Apps cannot use these Flutter shapes with ShapeDecoration, ClipPath::shape or Material-style shape parameters; the circle case needs a BoxShape workaround and the others are unavailable.
limitations: Source inventory only. Material-only consumers (notched shapes) are excluded.
title: Shape border family lacks CircleBorder, OvalBorder, BeveledRectangleBorder, ContinuousRectangleBorder and LinearBorder
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

cause: Gradient descriptors carry stops and endpoints only; no transform stage is part of the gradient value.
evidence: rg for GradientTransform and GradientRotation in crates/*/src finds nothing; the gradient constructors take stops and geometry without a transform argument. RadialGradient focal parameters are absent by the same search.
fix_direction: Add a renderer-neutral gradient transform to the gradient descriptor and apply it in the gradient shader or lowering.
impact: Rotated linear gradients and gradients with a transformed origin cannot be expressed; apps must rotate the decorated box or approximate the effect.
limitations: Source inventory only; no pixel scene. The Flutter positionDependentBox behavior is unchecked.
title: Gradients have no transform, rotation or focal parameters
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md
verification_note: Verification: radial focal parameters exist; only GradientTransform is missing.

cause: AssetImage is a single-path provider; the configuration hook exists but is not implemented for variant lookup.
evidence: AssetImage implements only load(), which reads its path (lib.rs:144-147). It does not override load_with, so the ImageConfiguration passed to load_with is ignored. No variant resolution exists for scale folders, and ExactAssetImage has no counterpart.
fix_direction: Implement load_with for AssetImage that selects a variant from the device pixel ratio and locale, with the Flutter fallback order.
impact: Apps that ship 2x and 3x asset variants load the 1x file on high-density displays, and locale-specific assets are never selected.
limitations: Source reading; the variant-selection order is not compared with Flutter.
title: AssetImage ignores device-pixel-ratio and locale variants
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

cause: The Lerp implementations for these types clamp t, while the tween path passes the unclamped curve output through them. The Tween trait used elsewhere explicitly does not clamp.
evidence: Paired h.value scenario at t=1.5 from EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(8,4,12,16) to (20,0,6,2): Flutter left 26, top -2, right 3, bottom -5; Incular 20, 0, 6, 2. paint__data__alignment_lerp_extrapolated diverges the same way (Flutter x=y=2, Incular 1). Both Flutter values extrapolate; Incular clamps. The BorderSide clamp is source-only. paint__data__border_radius_lerp_extrapolated matches, because Radius lerp does not clamp t.
fix_direction: Remove the t clamp from the Lerp implementations for EdgeInsets, Alignment, FractionalOffset, the directional variants and BorderSide, so extrapolation matches Flutter; keep endpoint exactness.
flutter_ref: painting/edge_insets.dart:698-712 (EdgeInsets.lerp uses ui.lerpDouble, unclamped); painting/alignment.dart:463-472 (Alignment.lerp); ui lerp.dart:13-24
impact: With an overshooting curve (for example elasticOut) driving a LerpTween of insets or alignment, the overshoot is removed: the padding or alignment stops at the endpoint instead of overshooting as in Flutter. The animation consequence is source-derived from LerpTween::evaluate and is not frame-verified for AnimatedPadding or AnimatedAlign.
incular_ref: crates/incular-config/src/insets.rs:227-236 (EdgeInsets Lerp, t.clamp); crates/incular-config/src/alignment.rs:184-189 (Alignment Lerp, t.clamp), :229 (FractionalOffset), :287 (AlignmentDirectional); crates/incular-widgets/src/painting_effects/decoration.rs:102-110 (BorderSide Lerp); crates/incular-animation/src/value.rs:296-310 (LerpTween evaluate passes curve output to Lerp)
limitations: Overshoot-curve animation not frame-verified. anim_curves-001 reports the same class of clamp for size and rect tweens; this finding covers the paint data types and is not a duplicate of it.
title: EdgeInsets, Alignment and BorderSide lerps clamp the interpolation factor
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

cause: Hue is normalized at the value constructor before Lerp sees it.
evidence: Scenario lerps hue 300 to 360 at t=0.5: Flutter 330, Incular 150. Incular normalizes the endpoint 360 to 0 at construction, so the interpolation runs 300 to 0. The saturation sample (1 to 0.5 at t=0.5, both sides 0.75) matches.
fix_direction: Keep the stored hue in the Flutter range when it is 360, or interpolate on the unnormalized values and apply the modulo after lerp, matching HSVColor.lerp.
flutter_ref: painting/colors.dart:178-195 (HSVColor.lerp: lerpDouble on hue then % 360; fromAHSV accepts hue up to 360)
impact: Colors interpolated across the 360 boundary in HSV give the wrong hue. Flutter also accepts 360 as a valid hue, so the same input differs.
limitations: Only the hue endpoint 360 is covered by the scenario; the Flutter interpolation for other wrapping inputs was not compared.
title: HsvColor lerp wraps hue 360 to 0 before interpolating
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

cause: The WGPU backend has no shader-mask stage; the lowering treats the unsupported stage as a frame error.
evidence: lowering.rs:485-495: a PushShaderMask whose parent clip is not empty calls unsupported_effect and returns Err(UnsupportedShaderMask) for the whole frame. The behavior is documented on ShaderMask (compositing.rs:60-70) and covered by crates/incular-wgpu/tests/unsupported_effects.rs:21-63 and crates/incular-desktop/tests/unsupported_effect_execution.rs:84. Reproduction: build a scene whose visible subtree contains ShaderMask::new(callback, child) and present it through incular-wgpu; presentation returns RendererError::UnsupportedShaderMask for that frame, and the child is not drawn unmasked.
fix_direction: Implement the mask stage in WGPU, or downgrade to the child unmasked with a diagnostic; the orchestrator should decide which policy is acceptable for the parity target.
impact: Any app using ShaderMask on the WGPU backend loses the frame, so the scene does not update while the mask is present. This is documented and tested fail-closed behavior, but it is a missing common feature with a frame-level failure rather than a degraded paint.
limitations: Designed and tested behavior, not an unintended crash. Pixel comparison is impossible until the stage exists. Whether a real application frame loop recovers from the error was not checked.
title: ShaderMask makes the WGPU frame fail instead of painting
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md
